page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with a short marginal note at the right beside the third paragraph.

p.i: hoc fit vitio parentum, & senum, qui cū iuniores ad virtutem & pietatem hortari deberent, eos ad scelera pelliciunt. Ludi & artium magistri officium suum negligenter faciunt. Ut multa paucis complectar omnes sexus, aetates, & ordines hominum corrupti & depravati sunt, nec reformationis spes est.
Ne mireris ergo, cur Deus tam diuturna fame nos exerceat, graviora meriti sumus.
Si vero caritas annonae, et fames, (obijcis,)

est poena peccati, cur ab hac poena pij ac fideles non sunt immunes? Certum enim est omnibus temporibus multos pios & bonos viros famem pertulisse, ut nihil jam dicam de Abrahamo, Isaaco & Iacobo quos hinc inde migrare fames compulit, de quibus proxima concione plura diximus. Nonne diuturna illa fame, qua Deus Israelitas Achabi tempore afflixit, multi quoque pij viri afflicti sunt? Ipse enim Deus Heliae affirmat 7000. adhuc viros superesse qui genua Baali non flexerint, hoc est, qui externis gestibus nullum ei honorem detulerint. page.notes: The marginal note is printed as "Pij fame§ / Deo exer- / centur."; the "§" is read as printed but is doubtful. "Nonne" may carry an accent over the o as printed ("Nónne"); read here as plain "Nonne". The tilde in "cū" (cū iuniores) is read as an abbreviation mark for cum. The paragraph break before "Ne mireris" and before "Si vero" is judged from short line endings and may need checking. No reference mark in the text matches the marginal note, so the note is not linked with curly braces. The running head is shown without the page number.
